title: Agenda Creator (StorylineAndReview)

scenarios.title: Agenda Creator applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Agenda Creator (BtnAgendaWizard) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Agenda page numbers are frozen at generation time
scenarios.expected: Pinned current behavior: agenda page numbers are frozen at generation time - generation writes item.PageNumber from the divider slide's SlideIndex exactly once and no save or sync path recomputes it. Fix-forward target for AG-S1+: refresh page numbers on save. The host-free pin asserts the generation-time write, the single-write invariant and the absence of any page-number method.

scenarios.title: A deck carries exactly one fixed-tag agenda definition
scenarios.expected: Pinned current behavior: a deck carries exactly one agenda definition, held in the single fixed oPE_AgendaMain tag with the constant value "True" - there is no per-agenda name or identity slot. Fix-forward target for AG-S1+: multiple named agendas with an explicit active one.

scenarios.title: Agenda sync is capture-clear-regenerate-restore without a diff review
scenarios.expected: Pinned current behavior: agenda synchronization runs capture-clear-regenerate-restore (GetContentSlideMap, ClearExistingAgendaSections, ClearExistingDividerSlides, regenerate, RestoreContentSlidePositions) with no diff-first review stage before manual edits are overwritten. Fix-forward target for AG-S1+: present the pending changes as a reviewable diff before applying them.

scenarios.title: Agenda Wizard window opens in real PowerPoint and reports its window state
